# Xcode 27 preview CI

`Xcode 27 Expo fixture` is a compile-only early-warning lane. It uses Node `20.20.2` and the repository's compatibility scripts to generate an Expo SDK 57 app, resolves and prints the actual Expo patch version, configures Customer.io with FCM and static frameworks, prebuilds iOS, and compiles the generated workspace. It complements, and does not replace, the existing macOS 26 and Xcode 26 compatibility workflows. A pass does not prove app launch, lifecycle callback forwarding, push delivery, or device behavior.

The `xcode-27` runner label is a floating GitHub public preview, not an immutable image selector. The local guard therefore fails before generation unless the runner still matches image `20260805.0079.1`, macOS `26.5.2` (`25F84`) on `arm64`, Xcode 27.0 beta 4 build `27A5228h` at `/Applications/Xcode_27_beta_4.app`, the `iphoneos27.0` and `iphonesimulator27.0` SDKs, and runtime `com.apple.CoreSimulator.SimRuntime.iOS-27-0`. The workflow prints every observed value.

`preview-infrastructure-drift` means the floating runner moved and requires pin review. `fixture-preparation-failure` means app generation, dependency resolution, or prebuild failed, so no compile conclusion exists. `sdk-compile-failure` means the complete guard and fixture preparation passed, then the generated iOS project failed to compile.

Squad Mobile owns this pin. When the official [Xcode 27 preview announcement](https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/14404) or [image inventory](https://github.com/actions/runner-images/blob/main/images/macos/xcode-27-arm64-Readme.md) changes, update the constants in `.github/actions/verify-xcode-27-preview/action.yml` only after verification. The same reviewed values must be updated in the native iOS and Flutter repositories in the same tracking work, and this fixture plus the existing Xcode 26 jobs must remain required evidence. Git history retains prior values for diagnosis; it cannot make a retired hosted image runnable.
